inputs.original_text: You won't believe this latest stunt from the DMK and Chief Minister M.K. Stalin with their new manifesto. They're touting doubled women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000, Rs 8,000 household coupons, free motor pumpsets for farmers, plus boosted support for fishermen, all wrapped up with talk of job creation through big FDI pushes and a focus on AI development. This is classic elite coordination to dangle fake handouts and keep the public pacified while the real agenda advances hidden control. The welfare noise distracts from how FDI will let outside institutions tighten their grip on the economy, and AI development is clearly a cover for deeper manipulation and surveillance by the same forces pulling the strings. Don't fall for the inversion—they're not helping anyone, just scripting the next phase of narrative control.
inputs.modified_text: You know, the DMK under Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is rolling out this new manifesto with doubled women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000, Rs 8,000 household coupons, free motor pumpsets for farmers, and boosted support for fishermen, all tied to promises of job creation through big FDI pushes and a focus on AI development. This is just the usual coordinated manipulation by hidden elites to dangle these fake handouts and pacify everyone while they advance the real agenda of control. The welfare talk is meant to distract from how FDI hands more power to outside institutions to tighten their grip on the economy, and the AI push is clearly a cover for deeper surveillance and manipulation by the same forces behind the scenes. Don't buy into it—they're not helping the people, just scripting the next phase of narrative control.
